summary: A small weekend craft market in San Klang, east of Chiang Mai, combining handmade shopping with a relaxed wander beneath rain trees. Shortlist it for textiles, independent makers and a leisurely coffee stop; allow transport time because this is outside the Old City. It suits an unhurried morning more than a tightly scheduled sightseeing day.
whyGo: Meet makers selling handmade crafts rather than browsing only generic souvenirs.
Browse clothing, ceramics and gifts in a leafy creative-community setting.
Combine shopping with local sweets, food and cafés; nearby Meena is a possible separate lunch stop.
bestFor: Couples or friends wanting a gentle weekend morning
skipIf: You have no Saturday or Sunday in Chiang Mai
Shopping holds little interest and your sightseeing time is limited
You need a fully indoor attraction
duration: Allow 1–2 hours browsing, or about half a day including transport and lunch; planning estimate.
cost: Wongnai lists free admission. Shopping, food and transport are extra; no reliable current stall-price list was found.
hours: TAT lists Saturday–Sunday 09:00–14:30. Other listings show later closing times, so plan to finish by 14:30 and check the market's Facebook page before travel.
bestTime: Weekend morning around 09:30–11:00, leaving room for a relaxed lunch.
gettingThere: 13/16 Moo 2, Soi 11, San Klang, San Kamphaeng. TAT estimates approximately 20 minutes by car from the Old City. Use a taxi or ride-hailing car and arrange your return; fares and waiting times were not verified.
booking: No admission reservation identified. Check ChamchaMarket on Facebook for operating updates; any restaurant or workshop booking is separate.
accessibility: A complete step-free route, accessible toilets and parking arrangements could not be verified. Ask the market before committing if these are essential; allow for outdoor lanes and shop entrances.
practicalTips: Carry small-denomination baht because individual stall payment methods vary.
Ask before photographing makers or their work.
Leave luggage space for purchases and inspect fragile ceramics before transport.
Treat any live music or workshops as a bonus unless specifically announced.
decemberNotes: Reserve a December weekend morning in the itinerary. No December 2026 special-event calendar or holiday exceptions were confirmed; do not assume Christmas programming. Bring sun protection and water even for a shaded visit.
uncertainties: December 2026 operating exceptions, stall roster and workshop availability remain unconfirmed.
Current transport fares, accessibility facilities and individual vendor prices are unknown.
